technical.summary: STZ shows bullish structure with golden cross and price above key MAs, but extreme RSI9 overbought condition, stoch bearish cross, and weak ADX trend strength create elevated pullback risk; moderate entry quality with caution warranted.

fundamental.summary: STZ shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 28 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (12/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (2 sales vs 1 purchase, all small amounts, all dated 105+ days ago) provides no conviction support.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (347.2) and flat yield curve create severe macro headwinds; NFP event in 1 day adds near-term volatility risk; earnings in 28 days provides moderate buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable for STZ.
